title: viola tricolor subsp. hortensis
intro: Viola tricolor subsp. hortensis, commonly known as Pansy, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Violaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Pansy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as inhibiting the growth of microorganisms and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Pansy include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions, including hypertension and gastrointestinal disorders.
